title: Baltic Freight 1: Your first day
lead: Today is your first day as a logistics assistant at Baltic Freight in Kaunas. You meet your manager Marta, plan a delivery to Riga and visit the warehouse.
how: You work at Baltic Freight, a logistics company. Choose what you say.
Green ✓ is right. Red ✕ is not this one. You can try again and you will see what to say. Right the first time? You get a star ★.
Tap an underlined word to see what it means.

words.definition: a person who is in charge of people and work
words.example: Marta is a logistics manager in a big company.

words.definition: things that people make and sell
words.example: Logistics is the work of moving goods from one place to another.
Good logistics means the customer gets the right product at the right time.

words.definition: the work of moving and storing goods
words.example: Logistics is the work of moving goods from one place to another.

words.definition: all the steps from the factory to the customer
words.example: Every step is part of the supply chain.

words.definition: to ask a company to send you goods
words.example: A customer in Riga orders ten boxes of office chairs.

words.definition: having the job of taking care of something
words.example: She is responsible for the budget, and she must not spend too much money.

words.definition: the last day or time to finish something
words.example: The deadline is Friday, so the truck must leave on Wednesday.

words.definition: the road or way from one place to another
words.example: First, they choose the best route.

words.definition: to put goods into a truck or a ship
words.example: Workers load the boxes and a driver checks the shipment.

words.definition: a person who drives a truck or a car
words.example: Workers load the boxes and a driver checks the shipment.

words.definition: a group of goods that are sent together
words.example: Workers load the boxes and a driver checks the shipment.

words.definition: a situation when something is late
words.example: If there is a delay on the road, the driver calls the office.

words.definition: a small vehicle that lifts heavy things
words.example: A forklift lifts the heavy pallets and moves them to the trucks.

words.definition: black lines on a product that a machine can read
words.example: Every product has a label with a barcode.

words.definition: to read a barcode with a machine
words.example: He scans each barcode with a small machine.

words.definition: a flat wooden base for carrying many boxes
words.example: Then he puts the products on a pallet and packs them.
